paragraphs: Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 26:7 and Midrash Shmuel 24:6.

notes.text: The Midrash Shmuel locator פ״כר־ו is malformed; it may contain an error for another numeral.

The saved named Krakow 1893 Midrash Shmuel chapter 24, sixth segment, explicitly names Yitzchak bar Chiyya. This supplies a 24:6 comparison alongside the frozen פ״כר־ו, without proving that a printer substituted ר for ד. The old guess כו is not adopted, and no fresh chapter-26 nonmatch inspection is claimed. Vayikra Rabbah 26:7 remains supplied.

Hyman’s printed page (vol. II, p. 791) reads פ״כד־ו, Midrash Shmuel 24:6. The supplied Hebrew transcription has פ״כר־ו. In the Krakow edition of Midrash Shmuel the speaker is Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chiyya; the parallel at Vayikra Rabbah 26:7 has Rabbi Yitzchak son of Rabbi Chiyya. In both passages he explains why Saul did not consult the Urim and Tummim.
